questions.q: What first made Jim notice the strange figure on the hillside?
choices: A spout of gravel fell rattling down the hill
He heard it singing
He smelled smoke from its fire
It called out his name
questions.evidence: a spout of gravel was dislodged and fell rattling and bounding through the trees

questions.q: When Jim first saw the shaggy creature, why did he turn back toward the boats?
choices: He preferred the dangers he knew to the ones he did not
He wanted to warn Silver
He had left his pistol in the boat
He was hungry and wanted food
questions.evidence: I began to prefer the dangers that I knew to those I knew not

questions.q: What gave Jim the courage to walk toward the man of the island?
choices: He remembered he had a pistol
He saw the man was smiling
He heard the ship's gun
The man dropped his weapon
questions.evidence: the recollection of my pistol flashed into my mind

questions.q: What did the man do when Jim walked toward him?
choices: He threw himself on his knees and clasped his hands
He ran away up the hill
He attacked Jim
He climbed a tree
questions.evidence: threw himself on his knees and held out his clasped hands in supplication

questions.q: Ben Gunn says he was "marooned." As Jim explains, being marooned means:
choices: Being put ashore and left behind on a lonely island as punishment
Being shipwrecked in a storm
Being made captain of a ship
Being lost at sea in a small boat
questions.evidence: left behind on some desolate and distant island

questions.q: How long had Ben Gunn been alone on the island?
choices: Three years
Three months
Ten years
One week

questions.q: What food had Ben Gunn dreamed about on many long nights?
choices: Cheese, mostly toasted
Roast beef
Fresh bread
Apples
questions.evidence: many's the long night I've dreamed of cheese--toasted, mostly

questions.q: What did Ben Gunn say he had lived on while on the island?
choices: Goats, berries, and oysters
Fish and coconuts
Turtles and seaweed
Ship's biscuits he had saved
questions.evidence: lived on goats since then, and berries, and oysters

questions.q: When Ben whispered "I'm rich," what did Jim think at first?
choices: That the poor fellow had gone crazy from being alone
That Ben was lying to trick him
That Ben was a famous lord
That Ben had stolen the ship's money
questions.evidence: I now felt sure that the poor fellow had gone crazy in his solitude

questions.q: How did Ben Gunn react when he learned that Silver was on the ship?
choices: He was frightened and wrung Jim's wrist
He laughed and said Silver was his friend
He wanted to go and greet Silver
He did not care at all
questions.evidence: If you was sent by Long John," he said, "I'm as good as pork

questions.q: What two things did Ben Gunn want from the squire in exchange for his help?
choices: One thousand pounds and a passage home
A new ship and a crew
A house and a servant's uniform
A barrel of rum and a pistol

questions.q: According to Ben Gunn, how did Flint return after burying the treasure?
choices: Alone in a little boat, with all six of his men dead
With all six men carrying gold
Swimming back to the ship
He never returned at all
questions.evidence: the six all dead--dead and buried

questions.q: Why was Ben Gunn left behind on the island by his second ship?
choices: His messmates searched twelve days for the treasure, found nothing, and blamed him
He fell asleep and missed the boat
He wanted to stay and live alone
He had started a fight with the captain
questions.evidence: Twelve days they looked for it, and every day they had the worse word for me

questions.q: Ben Gunn hints that most of his time on the island "was took up with another matter." What is he most likely hinting about?
choices: He has found Flint's treasure
He has built a large house
He has been training goats
He has been writing a book
questions.evidence: the most part of his time was took up with another matter

questions.q: What did Ben Gunn say he had that might get Jim back aboard?
choices: A boat he made himself, kept under the white rock
A raft hidden in the swamp
A secret tunnel to the anchorage
A signal fire on the hill
questions.evidence: I keep her under the white rock

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Jim meets Ben Gunn, a marooned man who may become an ally
Jim fights a wild bear in the woods
Jim returns to the ship and warns the captain
Silver captures Jim near the marsh
questions.evidence: I began to believe that I had found an ally
